title: Exploring The Empirical Privacy Landscape of Synthetic Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.22659v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Methods for training language models on sensitive data differ in how they balance capability gains against the risk of leaking private information. In this paper, we present a controlled comparison of data-level and training-level interventions for navigating the capability-privacy tradeoff on synthetic medical records with canaries to probe for leakage. Direct finetuning performs best on capability metrics but leads to the most privacy leakage, while DP-SGD reduces leakage at substantial cost to capabilities. Generating synthetic data from these records offers a more favorable balance, particularly when guided by a uniqueness-aware instruction to replace private details. Relative to naive paraphrasing, privacy-aware rewriting improves privacy protection across a variety of different rewriting models. We also find that more capable rewriting models generally reduce the risks of downstream privacy leakage, although held-out fit does not

translated_title: 探索合成数据的实证隐私图景
translated_abstract: 在敏感数据上训练语言模型的方法，在能力提升与泄露隐私信息风险之间的权衡上各有不同。本文中，我们在带有金丝雀（canaries）以探测泄露的合成医疗记录上，对数据层面和训练层面的干预措施进行了受控比较，以研究能力与隐私之间的权衡。直接微调在能力指标上表现最佳，但导致的隐私泄露最多；而 DP-SGD 虽然降低了泄露，却以能力的大幅损失为代价。从这些记录生成合成数据则提供了更有利的平衡，尤其是在“感知唯一性”指令的引导下替换私人细节时效果更佳。与朴素的改写方法相比，隐私感知改写在多种不同的改写模型上都能提升隐私保护水平。我们还发现，能力更强的改写模型通常能降低下游隐私泄露的风险，尽管留出集拟合（held-out fit）并不能（预测这一点）。
tldr: 本研究通过对合成医疗记录的受控比较发现，从敏感记录生成合成数据（尤其是结合隐私感知改写）比直接微调或 DP-SGD 训练能更好地平衡语言模型的能力与隐私保护。
en_tdlr: Through a controlled comparison on synthetic medical records, this study shows that generating synthetic data from sensitive records—especially with privacy-aware rewriting—offers a more favorable capability-privacy tradeoff than direct finetuning or DP-SGD.
